protocol.name: Tokenised GBP (tGBP)
protocol.summary: tGBP is a regulated, FCA-registered British Pound stablecoin issued by BCP Technologies, designed to act as a secure, institutional-grade fiat-to-crypto gateway enabling GBP-denominated settlement, payments, and asset pairs across prominent global exchanges, banks, and on-chain venues.
protocol.constraints: Wnode remains stateless and non-custodial. All tGBP interactions must be ephemeral, executed in-memory, and cleared without retention. No private keys, logs, or wallet state persist after execution.

integration.type: Wnode integrates tGBP as a programmatic fiat-backed settlement and liquidity rail, utilizing non-custodial API integrations and smart contract drivers to automate multi-venue transactional flows securely within memory.
data_flows: Agents initiate GBP-denominated transfers using tGBP across supported venues.
Liquidity routing flows between exchanges, banks, and on-chain pools using tGBP as the settlement asset.
All transaction metadata is processed in RAM and wiped immediately after confirmation.
security: Ephemeral signing keys per execution cycle.
No custody or persistent state; Wnode acts only as a transient compute substrate.
Encrypted in-memory processing with immediate memory wipe on settlement confirmation.

value_to_wnode.gbp_settlement: Provides Wnode agents with a compliant, predictable, and fully backed British Pound settlement mechanism, eliminating the volatility of non-stablecoin fiat alternatives.
value_to_wnode.liquidity: Enables seamless programmatic connectivity and capital reallocation across major liquidity venues like Coinbase, Kraken, and Wirex to optimize automated agent corporate treasuries.
value_to_wnode.compliance: Leveraging an FCA-registered issuer drastically lowers regulatory friction, aligning Wnode's execution environment with institutional compliance standards.

value_to_tgbp.volume: Wnode's autonomous agent mesh generates a consistent, high-frequency baseline of transactional and settlement volume via automated treasury, payroll, and trading executions.
value_to_tgbp.distribution: Expands tGBP's market penetration directly into machine-driven machine-to-machine (M2M) payment networks and automated enterprise treasury systems.
value_to_tgbp.positioning: Establishes tGBP as the infrastructure standard and default sterling-denominated fiat rail across sovereign compute meshes.

agent_capabilities: Route GBP liquidity across exchanges and banks
workflow_examples: An agent receives a GBP settlement instruction, constructs a tGBP transfer, verifies confirmation, and wipes all session data.
A treasury agent rebalances GBP liquidity between Coinbase, Kraken, and on-chain pools using tGBP.
An agent automates GBP payroll or vendor payments using tGBP without holding gas tokens.
